data.header_description:
Beginnings can be difficult. Especially when it comes to a demanding IT career. During BUGinnings in IT - our series of stationary events, we meet with experts from the IT industry with years of experience and broad expertise.

They share their own career stories, setbacks & lessons learned and advise about dos and don’ts related to the first big decisions in the IT profession.

The sessions can be a vast inspiration not only to the IT students, engineering interns, and specialists on the junior positions but also for those who’d think of moving to IT from another field.
